verdict.rationale: A state tax agency could plausibly publish bulk statistical datasets or extracts, so the axis applies. The evidence covers only account-based transactions (filing, payments, notices) and interactive lookups such as the penalty calculator, the STAR delivery schedule lookup and the due-date calendar. None of these is a bulk downloadable dataset or extract, and the probes found no machine-readable API surfaces.

support.subject: As a developer, the service publishes bulk public-data downloads or extracts (datasets, registry extracts, wage or case statistics) that need no scraping
